throughline.zh: 本週台灣稀土材料與電力基礎設施公布不同階段資訊，東南亞則涵蓋海纜招標與資料中心投資意向；高科技貨運的最新管理階層陳述提供另一個出貨物流角度。
throughline.en: This week's developments cover Taiwan rare-earth planning and power restoration, a Southeast Asian cable tender and data-center investment intention, plus new management comments on high-tech airfreight.

title.zh: 稀土材料與精密設備供應鏈

summary.zh: 工研院 10 月 24 日表示，規劃 2028 年底完成稀土示範廠、2030 年達年產 500 噸，預期可滿足台灣約半數需求。建廠預算、地點及實際磁材產出尚未核定。
summary.en: On October 24, ITRI described plans for a rare-earth demo plant by end-2028 and annual output of 500 tonnes by end-2030, aimed at roughly half of Taiwan's demand. Funding, location and qualified material output remain unconfirmed.

title.zh: 颱風後供電復原與工廠電力、智慧系統
title.en: Storm recovery, factory power and smart systems

summary.zh: 10 月 24 日台電通報全台累計逾 34 萬戶曾停電，宜蘭區處於 25 日宣布下午 4 時完成逾 3 萬受災民生用戶復電；各項數字分屬不同時點和地區，尚無半導體工廠停機資料。中華電信另公布智慧影像子公司成立，未揭露工業端裝機量。
summary.en: Taipower reported more than 340,000 accounts affected nationwide on October 24, and Yilan declared restoration to over 30,000 affected household accounts by 4 p.m. October 25. The dates and geographies differ, with no fab downtime data. Chunghwa Telecom separately formed an intelligent-vision subsidiary without industrial installation figures.

title.zh: 東南亞海纜招標與馬來西亞資料中心投資意向
title.en: Southeast Asian cable tender and Malaysia data-center intentions

summary.zh: MViSTA 海纜開發商提出約 4 億美元建置估算與 2028 年底啟用目標；馬來西亞總理 24 日另轉述 500 億美元 AI／資料中心投資意向，媒體 25 日指涉 SoftBank 孫正義。兩案均缺少實際施工、併網及完工驗證，且投資金額不可視為已支出。
summary.en: The MViSTA developer estimates a roughly US$400 million cable with service targeted for late 2028. Malaysia's prime minister separately cited a US$50 billion AI/data-center investment intention on October 24, with media naming SoftBank's Masayoshi Son on October 25. Neither plan supplies approved construction or energization milestones; neither is realized spending.

title.zh: 台灣光互連合作與高科技設備物流
title.en: Taiwan optical interconnect and high-tech equipment logistics

summary.zh: 玉晶光與 3M 的光互連合作尚未確認量產交付；長榮航總經理 10 月 25 日稱 AI 伺服器等高科技貨運需求持續，但也指出航空燃油成本壓力。長榮航 9 月貨運營收年增 42.55%，為已公布的歷史營收數據，沒有拆分 AI 貨物量價。
summary.en: GSEO and 3M's interconnect collaboration has not published qualified production deliveries. On October 25 EVA Air cited sustained AI server and high-tech freight demand alongside fuel-cost pressure. September cargo revenue rose 42.55% year-on-year, but historical revenue does not isolate AI freight volume or pricing.

title.zh: 台菲半導體合作方向與 2030 年出口目標

summary.zh: 駐菲代表 10 月 24 日在馬卡蒂市提及串聯台菲與呂宋經濟走廊的可能性，並引用菲律賓 2030 年電子與半導體產品年出口 1,100 億美元目標。現階段未公告新的半導體工廠核定投資。
summary.en: Taiwan's envoy discussed a potential link between Taiwan-Philippines and Luzon economic corridors in Makati on October 24, citing the Philippines' US$110 billion 2030 electronics and semiconductor export goal. No new fab investment approval was announced.
